column3: Elyo kabili bonse nabafwala ifyampepo fyafiitulukila elyo namatoloshi yajinisi umwaume ilyamakumbimakumbi makumbi lyena mwanakashi ilyafiita
column4: Elyo kabili bonse babili nabafwala namatakii, lyena imbwa mwaume aikete, naifwika no mushipi wafiita mumukoshi kabili iyi mbwa yalibutukila
column5: ca cine, lyena aba babili balepusana no mwaume umbi ukwenda nao wine afwele campepo
column6: Cilemoneka ukuti nikucifulo kwatalala, elyo kabili aba bantu bali pantashi yeshitolo ilyakwata kabili lubali lumbi ulweshitolo kuli abantu bale-enda pamusebo

column2: pa nshita yabushiku, kuli abaume abale-enda pamusebo
column3: pantashi pali umwaume mukalamba lyena kunuma yakwe kuleisa akalumendo kanono
column4: Elyo kabili aka kalumendo nakasendepo fimo kumaboko kabili nakafwala nakasote
column5: Nomba bushe nikwisa aba bantu bali?
column6: bali kuncende yakwata fikuulwa fyantunti elyo kabili nakwaka ne nyali kuli icine cifulo

column2: Umwaume ali mubwato bwakwe ubwafiitulukila kabili ubulemoneka kwati bapanga namapulanga
column3: Nomba bushe uyu mwaume elecita finshi muli ubu bwato?
column4: Ali pa mumuna epo alepita no bwato bwakwe kabili nakwata ne cimuti ico aleseseshako amenshi pakutila ubwato butwalilile ukwenda ilyo pamumuna
column5: Elyo kabili mubwato bwakwe bwine nasenda nomuseke uwafiitulukila uuli kuntashi yabwato lyena ena ekele kumpela
column6: Elyo nakabili ali pamumuna uukalamba nga nshi na menshi yalemoneka ayamakumbi makumbi kabili pali notumabimbi tunono pali uyu wine mumana

column2: Abantu pabula nabeminina paunkoto, pali aba bantu pali abalumendo, abakashana elyo no mwana mwaume
column3: Aba bantu balemoneka balecita ifyapusanapusana, bushe finshi uyu mwaume akonteme alecita?
column4: Alelolesha muco babomfya pakumona ifintu fyalekanalekana ifya mulwele cili kwati alemwenako fimo ifili pantashi yakwe
column5: Lyena mupepi nankwe pali akamwana akalumendo, nakekata mumusana kabili kuminwe cili kwati nakekata nomupila
column6: Lyena nabashala bene balecita ifyalekanalekana mumabumba kabili lubali lumbi kuli na motoka iminine ukuli abantu abengi mupepiko ne mendela cilemoneka kwati paciba ifyacila citika kuli ici cicifulo

column2: Kucifulo cimo icayemba ukwaba ulunkoto lyakatapakatapa kuli umwaume wikele panse pa nshita yakasuba
column3: Kabili mupepi nankwe pali ne ncinga apo akobeke akachola kwakwe akafiita
column4: Elyo kabili panshi palunkoto pali nefyapala ifyakufwala, uyu mwaume alifye ubwamba tafwele nangu cimo kabili ilyo ekele nadangasana
column5: Cakupapa sana ico tafwalila, nomba bushe cinshi cilya akwete kumaboko yakwe?
column6: Ca cine kuti wapapa ica musango uyu, alebelenga fimo ifyapala ifipepala balembamo amalyashi ayacitika mucalo

column2: Umwano mwanakashi nabanyina bale-angala palunkoto kabili mupepi napo bali pali abantu bambi
column3: Uyu mwana mwanakashi nafwala nakapamuulu ako bafwala abantu nga baleipika elo nakamumishishi kabuuta
column4: Lyena banyina bena nabafwala ishati lyabuuta elyo nabasunsumana panshi pakutila balingane noyu mwana
column5: Nomba bushe finshi uyu mwana alecita kuli banyina?
column6: Nakwata utwapala utupepala twamalangi yapusanapusana utwingi alongele mucipepala cikalamba icafiitulukila kabili alebuula utu tupepala twamalangi alesansa mumishishi shabanyina kabili nabasekelela

column2: Pa nshita yakasuba panse kucifulo cimo kuli bashikulubantu bane abekele
column3: Kabili batatu pali aba bashikulubantu bekele pamupando umo lyena bamo bekele beka
column4: Ca cine, pali aba batatu, bamo bafwele ishati lyaputulwa amaboko ilyafiita kabili nabashintilisha nokuboko kumupando lyena bambi bafwele ilyabutulukila
column5: elyo abali kumpela bena bafwele ishati ilya makumbi makumbi, kabili bonse aba bashikulubantu balikwata na utufumo utukulu kwati nalimo tonse natulingenefye
column6: Cine, lyena shikulubantu ekele eka wena taina nga bena, afwele toloshi lyamakumbi makumbi kabili mupepi napo aba banu bekele pali ne tebulo cilepala kwati baletushako panse

column2: Umwaume naiminina kabili nasokola nolutungu lwakukulyo ilyo eminine
column3: Bushe finshi uyu mwaume alecita?
column4: Ukboko kwakwe kumo naikata kucilibwe cikalamba cili mupepi nankwe lyena kumbi naikata pa mpumi pakuti amweneshe bwino apatali alefwaya ukumona
column5: Ca cine sana kabili uyu alikucifulo kwabe mpili, nomba bushe cinshi maka maka alelolesha?
column6: Kuntashi uko uyu mwaume alelolesha kuli umumana panshi apatali napo ali kabili pali ne ngalaba iikalamba kabili iyabuuta

column2: Umulumendo naikala pamupando kabili ali kuntashi mukati ka ndeke
column3: Kabili uyu mulumendo afwele icapamuulu icobafwala ngabaleenshya indeke ica katapakatapa elyo ne shati lyabutulukila
column4: eilyo uyu mulumendo ekele alecitapo nafimo, bushe nawishiba ifyo alecita?
column5: Ee, alefwaya ukutinika amabatani yalikumuntenge wandeke nelyo cili kwati alesontapo fimo
column6: Ca cine sana, kabili iyi ndeke tayakwata amabatani kumuulu lelo namupepi napo ekele pantashi ponse pali amabatani, elyo kabilipacipuna cili mupepi nankwe tapali muntu uulingile ukwenshe ndeke

column2: Pa nshita yakasuba, akamwana akanakashi kaleangala
column3: Elyo kabili aka kamwana nakafwala nelaya lyamakumbi makumbi kabili kalikwata no mushishi wafiita
column4: Elyo kabili aka kamwana kale-angalila mupepi na pali ingamila yafiitulukila ikele panshi kabili naimya umutwe waiko
column5: Nomba bushe finshi aka kamwana kalecita?
column6: Kale-esha ukwikata ingamila kumatwi yaiko pakutila kaleyangasha, elyo kabili nakapapa ne chola munuma

column2: Kucifulo uko bacimfyamya mu cangalo kuli abaume babili abeminine
column3: Umwaume ali pantashi afwele ifyakashikila lyena uuli kunuma afwele icakatapakatapa, bushe cinshi ici uufwele icakashikila akwete kuminwe yakwe
column4: Nakwata icikombe, tecakutwishika ukuti nacimfya mucangalo cakucofe n'cinga pantu icilambu cakwe cikwete ncinga  no muntu pamuulu kabili uyu mwaume nasansamuka icine cine
column5: Ca cine no mwaume wine ali kunuma yakwe afwele amakalashi yafiita nao nasansamuka
column6: Ca cine sana lyena kunuma ya aba bantu palunkoto pali nabantu na bambi elyo na motoka ya mutuntula naiminina

column2: Umwaume nashintilisha kumulundu wamenshi makasa
column3: Nomba bushe finshi uyu mwaume acitile fi?
column4: Cilemoneka kwatinalimo acishelela pali ayamenshi nelyo kwati nanaka fye, nomba bushe naumona ifyo afwele?
column5: Ee, nimbona, uyu mwaume nafwala ifyakaba icine cine, icampepo, amakalafushi elto ne toloshi lyafiita ilyatikama
column6: Elyo nakabili uyu mwaume nafwala necakuifimba pamenso icakuti talemoneka kano fye amenso yakwe, lyena akatalamukila napo ali pali nefimuti fyamena pantashi ya ng'anda

column2: Akadoyo kapala ulushimu lwamakumbi makumbi kalepupuka mupepi ne luba
column3: Kabili ili line luba lisuma, lyalikwata amalangi yapusanapusana, ayakatapakatapa, ayamakumbi makumbi elyo nayabuuta
column4: Ca cine sana liluba ilisuma nga nshi, nomba bushe nawishiba ico aka kodoyo kapupuka kaleya mukucita?
column5: Kwena nshishibe bwino lelo ico njishibe fye cakuti kalikwata umulomo uutali
column6: Aka kashishi kalapanga ubuluba elyo kabili kalalya ifyakulya ukufuma muli aya maluba napali ino ine nshita efyo kaleya mukucita

column2: Mumuputule wakwikalamo muli bawishi abale-angasha akanya kabo
column3: kabili aba bawishi nabekata akanya kabo kabili nabasekelela icine cine na kanya nakena nakasekelela
column4: Ca cine kabili aka kanya nakabiika mucipuna babika utunya kabili nabakafimba ubulangeti bwabuuta lyena apo kasalele pali insalu yabutuluka
column5: Ca cine, kabili muli uyu wine muputule muli ne citunshitunshi cafiita ico babikile petebulo
column6: elyo kabili kucibumba mupepi ne citunshitunshi kuli nefyapala ifilimba ifyaikatako fitatu lyena kuli ne nyali mupepi necikope

column2: Umwanakashi ali mukati yacikuulwa icapala shitolo umo bashitisha ifintu fyalekanalekana
column3: Kabili uyu mwanakashi afwele ishati lyamakumbi makumbi elyo nafwala nakatambala kakashikila kumutwe wakwe
column4: Kabili mupepi napo yu mukashana eminine pali kabati, pali iyi kabati pali amabotolo yalekanalekana amakalashi
column5: Elyo kabili ifintu muli iyi kabati balifitantika ukulingana nobukulu ukubikako fye na pamuulu wakabati wine
column6: Ca cine, lyena pa ntshi yakabati pali itembulo ilitali apali amabotolo ayengi ayapusanapusana, mupepi ne tebulo epo mwanakshi alelolesha, cipalile kwati cikuulwa cintu bashitishamo amabotolo yamakalashi na fimbi ifyamakalashi

column2: Abaume babili balecofa incinga shabo mumusebo wamaloba, kabili kumbali yamusebo balimikako necishibilo capamusebo
column3: Kabili aba babili bafwele ifyampepo fyakashikila elyo namakaputula yafiita
column4: Elyo nakabili bonse babili nabafwala nefisote kumitwe yabo elyo namakalshi yafiita pa menso yabo
column5: elyo nakabili cilemoneka kwati napapa notufyola tunono munuma, lyena umo natangilako panono ilyo alecofa
column6: Kabili uyu wine atangile alemonekako mwaice lyena uushalileko panono alemoneka mukalamba, kabili aba babili balecofela incinga shabo mupepi ne fyani fyauma mumbali

column2: Umwanakshi naikala pa lunkoto kabili mupepi nankwe pali inkunda ishingi
column3: Uyu mwanakashi afwele ifyakufwala fya jinisi kabili aleloleshe inkunda, bushe mulandu shifulile fi?
column4: Nipamulandu wakuti paminwe shintu uyu mwakashi atambike nkuna pali ifyakulya ifyo alepele nkunda emulandu shimunkungile
column5: Kabili mupepi nankwe pali chola cakatapakatapa elyo pali no mwanakashi asunsumene uulelanda pali lamya yakwe
column6: Nakuba kuli ici cifulo kuli abantu abengi pantu kunuma ya uyu mukashana kuli nabambi abaume elyo nabakashana abalecita fyalekanalekana cilemoneka nikucifulo cakutushishapo

column2: Umukashana naiminina nakontaminako na panshi
column3: Uyu mukashana afwele akaputula, ishati elyo nakaka notusalu kumaboko, bushe mulandu afwalile muli yu musango?
column4: Nipamulandu wakuti uyu mwanakshi aleteye cangalo cakuuma akamupila kanono ukubomfya icakuminako cili kumaboko yakwe
column5: Nomba bushe nikwisa ku ali pantu alemoneka kwati nalimo nasakamana?
column6: efyo alemoneka kwena, ali kucifulo bateyela ci cangalo, kabili mupepi nankwe pali linga lyafiita ilyo bapanga nefyela munshila yamasumbu, kuli abantu abeminine

column2: Umwaume uufwele ishati lyamakumbi makumbi ali mucikuulwa umuli ifintu fyalekanalekana
column3: Nomba bushe mulandu nshi ifyakufwala fyakwe filemonekela ifyalamba?
column4: Nipamulandu wakuti alembomba, kabili pali iyi nshita alebomfya kamashini akawaminisha no kutuula mu fyela namuma pulanga
column5: Kanshi emulandu wine alemonekele fi, elyo kabili ifyo aletula filefumya notumulilo utulesabuka apo ali
column6: ca cine, elyo paicingilila kucongo nafwala ne fyakushinka matwi yakwe ilyo alebomba

column2: Abaume babili nabeminina kucifulo cabusaka, nabafwala amakalashi yafiita, kabili nababika sana amano amano kufyo balecita
column3: Umo mwaume nanina pamuulu kumulando wacimuti kabili kabili naikatilila akapampa kanono kuminwe
column4: Lyena mwaume ali panshi nao naolola ukuboko kwakwe alefwaya ukupoopa akapampa kanono kantu uyu mwaume akwete kumaboko yakwe
column5: Elyo nakabili pamuulu wa ici cine cimuti batema pali necilubi ca golide icakwa chula ico babikapo mupepi neci cilubi epali ukuboko kwa uyu mwaume ali pa muulu
column6: Kabili kuli ici cine cimuti kuli nacimbi icipampa cikulileko icapoopwa kuli cene kabili calibuuta ne filembo fyakatapakatapa

column2: Abaume babili bali kuncende imo ukuli ifikuulwa fyantunti, kabilibali nanamayo akwete umushishi wakashikila
column3: Umwaume umo afwele shati lyaputulwa maboko kabili nasenda icapulashitiki icamuntuntula kabili alelola ukuli umwaume umbi
column4: Lyena uyu mwaume alelolako nao wine afwele shati lyafiita eminine nokwikata icashimbi ico babikilemo amaluba pamulu elyo kunse bafimbako pulashitiki
column5: Nomba bushe mulandu nshi uyu mwaume alemonekela fi kabili cinshi asontele nakulubantu iminwe yakwe?
column6: Nipamulandu wakuti nakulubantu aletuka uyu mwaume nsele ilyo emishe akakondo kwakwe akapakati

column2: Akamwana akalumendo kali pamusebo panshita yakasuba kabili kuminwe yakwe nakwata ne mbeketi yamakumbi makumbi
column3: Elyo kabili uyu mwana mulumendo nasekelela icine cine, nafwala ne laya lyafiita, nomba bushe cinshi cilya akwete kukuboko kumbi?
column4: Asendele ichola camakumbi makumbi kabili ale-enda mupepi no mwaume mukalamba uufwele laya lyabuuta elyo necitambala cabuuta
column5: Elyo kabili kunuma yakwe kuleisa no mwaume uufwele ifyakufwala fyabuuta ne myemfu shafiita kabili nasekelela icine cine
column6: Lyena kunuma ya uyu mwaume, kuli abaume bambi babili mupepi na motoka balelashanya, kabili akatalamukila lubali lumbi ulwamusebo umukalamba no mwaice abale-enda

column2: Ku ncende imo kuli ibumba lyabantu balekalekana, abaume elyo nabanakshi abale-enda pamusebo
column3: Kabili kuli ici cine cifulo kuli na bantu bambi abekele pafibumbili kwati nalimo balelolelapo bamo nelyo fimo
column4: Ca cine, kabili aba bantu bekele pa cibumbile bali mupepi sana na motoka babomfya pakubutusishamo abantu kucipatala iyabuuta
column5: Ni we wasosa kwena kanshi aba bantu bonse bali panse cipatala cikalamba icakwata intunti
column6: Ca cine, elyo kabili balicikuula busaka busaka, kabili muntu abantu balepita bale-enda munshi yacintelelwa kabili mupepi nabo pali musebo apali imyotoka

column2: Imbwa shibili shili mumpanga umwaba ifyani fyalepako panono kabili shilebutuka
column3: imbwa imo yalibutulukila lyena imbi yalifiitulukila
column4: Ca cine, imbwa yabutulukila ilemonekapo iikalambako panono ukucila iyafiitulukila
column5: Elyo kabili imbwa yabuutulukila naikwata no mushipi wafiitulukila uwamumukoshi lelo iinankwe taikwete
column6: Ca cine sana, kabili ishi mbwa shibili nashasama kabili nashifumya ne ndimi panse

column2: ibumba lya bantu balekanalekana apali abaume elyo nabanakshi bale-enda
column3: kabili aba bantu tabale-enda pamo kwati nalimobali mwibumba iyo, umwanakashi umo uufwele icaketi lyafiiulukila ne toloshi lyafiita ale-enda eka
column4: Lyena lubali lumbi ulwabulalo kuli ibumba lyabantu basano abafwele ifyafiita kabili bale-endela pamo, kabili aba bantu balemoneka ukuti bali ne nsansa sana
column5: Ca cine, kabili ubu bulalo babupanga  munshila yakuti bwalikwata ifiputulwa fyalekalekana ica kuti kuti paenda abantu abengi panshita imo ine
column6: Ca cine, elyo nakabili kuntashi sana ya ubu bulalo kuli ne fikuulwa fyalekanalekana ifyntunti

column2: Umukashana uwakwata amenso ayakulu kabili ayabulungana bwino ali mwituuka
column3: Kabili uyu mukashana afwele icakufwala cakashikila kunse lyena muli ne shati yafiita mukati
column4: Elyo kabili uyu mukashana nakwata nomunyololo wamumukoshi elyo kabili alifwala notukoosa twakumaboko utwingi kabili utwalekanalekana
column5: Ca cine twingi, elyo kabili pe tebulo emininepo pali utupepala tunono tunono utwamutuntula kabili nakwata utwa makumbi makumbi kuminwe yakwe
column6: Elyo kabili muntu aleshitisha mwalibe fitabo ifingi ifyalekalekana, elyo kabili kucibumba muli ililine tuuka balibikako ifikope ifingi nga nshi ifyalekanalekana

column2: Pa nshita yakasuba, bana babili bale-angala
column3: Umo pali aba bana mwanakashi lyena umbi umwana mwaume
column4: Kabili aba bana babili bale-angalila pancimpelwa icafiita icakwata intambo isho bakaka pamo
column5: Kabili akamwana akanakashi nakanina pamuulu sana lyena cili kwati nalimo kalelolesha fimo panshi
column6: Lyena akamwana kaume kena kalepeluka kwati nalimo kali mukwikala panshi

column2: Imbwa shitatu shileangala kucifulo ca maloba, kabili lubali lumbi kuli abaume batatu abali mupepi ne linga lya fyela
column3: Shibili pali ishi mbwa shalibuuta lyena imo yalifiitulukila
column4: Iyafiitulukila eilipo iikalamba kabili ilebuka pamo ne shi mbwa shino shibili
column5: Imbwa shinono shibili nashikwata umushipi wamumukoshi wapalana uwafiita, nomba bushe mulandu nshi shilebutukila?
column6: Shilepepeka akamupila kafiita akali pa ntashi yambwa ya buuta iitangile pantu imbi iyabuuta elyo neyafiitulukila shili kunuma yaiko

column2: Umwanakshi alekwelo lupili lwabuuta kabili naikata amaboko yakwe mumbali yalupili
column3: Kabili uyu mwanakashi afwele ishati lyafiitulukila elyo netoloshi lyafiita
column4: Elyo kabili mumusana wakwe muli amasenkebele yapusana amalangi kwati nalimo tutambo twingi akakile mumusana
column5: Ca cine kabili nakwata nakachola kanono mumusana wakwe mwine nomba bushe ifi aleisunka pakunina teti apone?
column6: Kwena kuti apona nomba nakwata ne ntambo mumusana wakwe iile panshi kuti yamucingilila nga cakuti aliisangile mubusanso ubuli bonse

column2: Umwanakashi alimucibansa mwakuteyela fyangalo kabili aleteye cangalo cakutoloko tushimbi
column3: Kabili uyu mwanakashi afwele fye akaputula kamukati akamakumbi makumbi nakashati kanono akashilo mutoto panse, mulandunshi pabelele mpendwa pe shati lyakwe?
column4: Ni pamulanndu wakuti uyu mwanakashi alecimfyanya nabantu bambi muli ci cine cangalo kabili ifi aletoloka akashimbi loto numa tafwile ukukumyako nelyo kuponya
column5: Kanshi emulandu wine abelele kwati nalimo nasalala ilyo aletoloka, cifwile cangalo cakosa ci
column6: Ee, pantu mupepi fye napo aletolokelela pali ne nkoloko yafiita ikalamba iyo babika panshi iipende nshita tafwile ukupulamo ninshi tekutila acimfye

column2: Umukashana nomulumendo bali pacisebele mucikuulwa pa nshita ya bushiku
column3: Umukashana afwele fyakufwala fyafitita elyo nakasote kabuuta kabili nakwata necisoselo kuminwe
column4: Lyeno mulumendo afwele ishati lyabuuta elyo ne toloshi lyafiita kabili naipamisha umutwe wakwe panshi lyena amolu mumuulu lyena ekete fye panshi nokuboko kumo
column5: Umwanakashi nao alemoneka kwati nalimo ale-endauka pa cisebele bushe kwena finshi alecita?
column6: Uyu mwanakashi aloleshe uko mwaume aleipilibulo mubili wakwe, aleimba ulwimbo no mweo wakwe kabili aleipakisha, aba babili balebmbela pakuyemfya ifyo balecita

column2: Umulumendo nasalala pa cibumbili yacikulwa panshita yakasuba
column3: uyu muluendo afwele ishati lyakashikila elyo netoloshi lya jinisi ilya makumbimakumbi kabili nafwala namakalashi
column4: Elyo kabili ilyo uyu mwaume asalele naolola ukulu kumo lyena kumbi naimya mumuulu
column5: Elyo nakabili nashintilisha umutwe wakwe pakuboko kumo apetele lyena kumbi nako naolola
column6: nakuba ilyo yu mwaume aselele, naisula nakanwa kakwe, kabili icikulwa cinti asalelepo calikwata amawindo yakalamba nga nshi

column2: Ibumba lya bantu apali abaume elyo nabanakashi nabalongana ku cifulo cimo busaka busaka
column3: Elyo kabili aba bantu nabafwala nefyakufwala fyakatapakatapa ifyapalana kabili nabakwata nefilimba
column4: Elyo aba bantu nabapanga na mabumba yabili, ilyabaume nelya banakashi kabili nabatantama busaka lyena pakati yamaumba yabili pali mwanakashi ali ne ng'oma
column5: Kabili kunuma ya aya mabumba kuli abantu bekele pa cabapanga ica fwela, kabili balipanga nga matabo pakuti abali pantanshi tabacinga abali kunuma
column6: Elyo kabili kuunma ya-aba bantu kuli ne hema likalamba iyabuuta noko kwine kuli abantu baletamba ifilecitika
